en-US.description: Cooperative gate for the shell commands AI coding agents run
en-US.longDescription: Command previews, automatic backups, allow/ask/deny policy, and audit logging for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Denies destructive commands by default, shows blast radius before approval, and takes a backup before execution.
en-US.name: Termaxa
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- A hard stop is read wherever the shell runs it: observe mode's floor holds rm -rf dist; kubectl delete ns prod, x=$(rm -rf /) and timeout 60 kubectl delete ns prod by @devdoc83 in #166
- Enforce mode lets a build directory go: a deny that says except_rebuilt does not apply to rm -rf node_modules by @devdoc83 in #167
- A substitution is read to the end or the line is refused: cat <(git push origin main) asks, and a hard stop five substitutions deep is denied by @devdoc83 in #168
- v0.21.9: a substitution hides no command, and enforce mode lets a build directory go by @devdoc83 in #169
Full Changelog: v0.21.8...v0.21.9
